test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ac_leaves (cid UInt64, vec Array(Float32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY cid
CREATE TABLE ac_coarse (cid UInt64, vec Array(Float32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY cid
CREATE TABLE ac_hier (cid UInt64, vec Array(Float32), level UInt8, parent UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY cid
CREATE TABLE ac_probes (id UInt64, v Array(Float32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE DICTIONARY ac_flat_dict (cid UInt64, vec Array(Float32)) PRIMARY KEY cid SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(DB 'default' TABLE 'ac_leaves')) LAYOUT(HASHED()) LIFETIME(0)
CREATE DICTIONARY ac_hier_dict (cid UInt64, vec Array(Float32), level UInt8, parent UInt64) PRIMARY KEY cid SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(DB 'default' TABLE 'ac_hier')) LAYOUT(HASHED()) LIFETIME(0)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ac_leaves SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> toFloat32((sipHash64(number % 256, i) % 10000) / 10000. + ((sipHash64(number, i, 7) % 10001) / 10000. - 0.5) * 0.1), range(64)) FROM numbers(65536)
INSERT INTO ac_coarse SELECT 1000000 + idx - 1, c FROM (SELECT hierarchicalKMeans(256)(vec) AS cs FROM ac_leaves) ARRAY JOIN cs AS c, arrayEnumerate(cs) AS idx
INSERT INTO ac_hier SELECT cid, vec, 1, 0 FROM ac_coarse
INSERT INTO ac_hier SELECT cid, vec, 0, 1000000 + assignCentroid(vec, (SELECT groupArray(vec) FROM (SELECT vec FROM ac_coarse ORDER BY cid))) FROM ac_leaves

INSERT INTO ac_probes SELECT n.number, arrayMap((x, i) -> toFloat32(x + ((sipHash64(n.number, i, 9) % 10001) / 10000. - 0.5) * 0.04), l.vec, range(64)) FROM numbers(4096) AS n INNER JOIN ac_leaves AS l ON l.cid = sipHash64(n.number) % 65536
